answer: Sybil floods inflate peer counts and steal attest weight. PoA68 resists by locking a glacier of stake that must cool for one full epoch before a new identity can attest: each raven scout posts a bonded deposit keyed to the challenge seed, then waits through a tundra of idle slots before voting. Cost is the locked stake plus lost rewards during cooldown. Verification checks bond height against epoch open and rejects zero-history keys. If a clone cluster fails the cool-down or reuses a deposit, peers slash the bond and drop those attestations so only aged identities keep quorum.
